lines.text: Jien.
My older half-sister.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: This is your sister. Go on, say hello.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Hello there, sweetie. My name's Jien.
A sister I'd never met, brought home out of nowhere by my beloved father.
She was clever and capable, and so...

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: Miss Syuen, did you hear?

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: They say Miss Jien developed a new Nikke brain-scan technology!

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: Apparently it can scan a Nikke even after it's lost its memories. Pretty impressive for someone so young, isn't it?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Lala, whose maid are you?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: If you like her that much, go work for her!

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: Oh my, don't say that! You'll always be the very best to me, young miss.
Sure, I was jealous that she got to work alongside Father,
but I didn't despise her to this extent.

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: Miss Syuen, Miss Jien is here to see you.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Again?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Hi, sweetie! Why don't we grab a bite together?
Even when I lashed out and pushed her away, she never gave up. She'd always show up, asking me to eat with her.
Even so, there was something unsettling about her.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: How come that thing's perpetually glued to your side? Is it your personal maid or something?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: That thing? Don't tell me you mean Lala?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Lala is not a "thing!"

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: She's... she's a maid who's precious to me!

lines.speaker: lala
lines.text: Oh my, young miss...!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Ah. Is that so.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: My apologies. I had no idea she meant so much to you.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind from now on.
Whenever I got angry, she'd immediately apologize and change her stance.
The reason I came to fear her so much...
*Bang*

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: !! Lala...?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: So, she was playing maid while spying on us all along.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Awfully brazen of her.
It all began the moment Lala died at my father's hand.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: You seem rather fond of that woman.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Every time I wonder where you've wandered off to, there you are, in Maxwell's lab.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Am I wrong?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I-I just go there sometimes.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Hmm... Sweetie.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Are you still angry with me?
Jien stops in her tracks.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Are you still sore about me turning that thing into a Nikke?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Don't talk about Lala like she's an object!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Lala is... Lala is...!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Your personal maid, and a spy. Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Which is why Father killed her.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... I know that.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: And despite knowing that, you're still angry?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Hmm... I don't quite understand.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I mean, that maid was caught spying, so Father shot her.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Since you were having such a hard time living without her,

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: I simply took the brain we had in storage at the lab and made it into a Nikke for you.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: What exactly is there to get so upset about?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Because that's not Lala!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: The brain's the same though, right?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: So what if it's the same brain! She doesn't remember anything at all!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: She doesn't have any memories of our time together... whatever that thing is, it's not Lala!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: It's nothing but scrap metal!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Ah, because she has no memories?

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: That part can't be helped.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: If you want to reuse the brain of someone who was a spy, a Memory Wipe is a must.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Who asked you to bring Lala back to life?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I never said I needed a maid!

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: But you cried every single day, sweetie.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Without that maid by your side, you wouldn't even eat or sleep properly.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: So naturally, I figured the only way to get back to your normal self would be to bring that maid back.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Turning her into a Nikke was the most efficient way to do so.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: It was all for your sake, don't you see?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: You don't know anything about me, so don't pretend it was all for me!

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: You know nothing... nothing, you hear me!
Syuen runs off.

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: jien_young
lines.text: Little sisters really are a handful.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Fix this.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Sorry? What are we fixing?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Didn't you see? The Central Government is pinning the Second Surface Reclamation War on us. I'm ordering you to do damage control.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You want... me to do that?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: You're in charge of the Nikkes' equipment, aren't you?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Develop something suitable and throw it their way.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you think something like that just appears the moment you snap your fingers?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Does it not?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Is that really all the chief of Missilis's equipment is capable of?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Fine. I'll do it. Sure, I'll just snap my fingers and make it happen.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But before I do, mind if I ask you something? Just out of curiosity.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Why did you commit yourself so fully to the Second Surface Reclamation War?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: What's wrong with giving the most important war in human history my full support?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: That was probably true for the First Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But definitely not for the Second War.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Countless mass-produced Nikkes from Missilis were secretly deployed.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: They went up to the surface carrying a suspiciously large number of devices.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Almost as if installing those devices was the real objective, and the outcome of the war didn't even matter.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What were those devices?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: An improved version of the Alva Particle Purification Device.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Huh? Why are you being so forthcoming?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: There's no reason to hide it.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Soon, communications will be strong enough to connect to Blabla even on the Surface.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Whoa, seriously? That'd be some insane performance.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But why not announce it? Something like this could completely turn public opinion around.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I'm saving it for something better. Handing this over for free would be a waste of my talent, don't you think?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hmm... Is that so...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Those devices... is that really all they're capable of?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: What more would there be?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Who knows?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Your talents are so very exceptional, after all.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Don't pretend like you have the brain cells to figure this out. It's a waste of time.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Right, well, this brain-cell-wasting wage slave will take her leave, then.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: How's the small one doing these days? I hear she's been treating your lab like it's her own room.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hang on... are you talking about Syuen?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Who talks about their own daughter like that?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I asked how she is.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen? Well, she's eating okay and having fun. She's growing up just fine.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: That's not what I'm asking.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Is she still hung up on that rust bucket maid of hers?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Come on. If you're worried about her, just say so. Why do you have to beat around the bush?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Answer me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: She's a lot better now. Turns out sweets are the best cure when kids are feeling down.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: And what has she been doing since coming out of her depression?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What's she been doing?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What else can a kid be doing? She watches TV and pokes around my lab...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: So, nothing but childish nonsense?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What do you expect from a child? Surely you're not expecting her to join me in my research, are you?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: She's part of the Missilis family. She ought to be different.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What, are people born into the Missilis family wired differently from everyone else?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Hmm. Seems like that method didn't work either...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Then it comes down to Jien after all...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: ... But the risk is far too great.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Are you talking about a successor?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Are you planning to retire, sir?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Eventually.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Now leave.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Okay, okay. I'm going.
Maxwell leaves the room.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: She still can't grow out of her childish habits...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Tsk.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The big one is far too inhuman,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: while the small one is far too human.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: ... And soft.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The only glimmer of hope is that the clever one has latched onto the small one.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: But that one's just as soft.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: For the sake of Missilis's future, placing the small one at the top would be the more efficient move.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: But if she can't fix that soft streak of hers, she's of no use to me.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: As things stand, the big one is my only recourse.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: ... Which isn't good.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If I put her in charge, she's bound to clash with Enikk.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: But the small one hasn't proven her ability to be put in charge.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: There's no telling whether she's simply too soft, or that she's truly incapable.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: If only the small one would show some capability, another path might open up.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: But... is that even possible?
Enme gazes at the screen.
On a vast map, a red zone is blinking.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Things are already in motion. There's no turning back now.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Now that it's begun... I can't afford to miss this opportunity.

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: The odds of the small one blossoming before then...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: I should start thinking of a way to put a leash on the big one.
